text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Just like that, um... please stop right there.
Now then, you can take off your blindfolds, um...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother...
Welcome to your Holiday Party...!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text: Oh, my word...! Did you prepare all of this for us, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone helped me out, um...!
It's not just the venue, we've prepared all sorts of other things too—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Th-Then, Karen-san, if you please...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haaai! Welcome, Papa and Mama~♪
I'm Karen, the one in charge of your outfits☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A chic suit for Papa, and a pure white A-line dress for Mama.
I styled them inspired by your wedding outfits~♪

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, how nostalgic! And Rice-chan and her friends put this together...? Goodness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I brought the food, um...!
It's a full French course from a popular restaurant—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The soup spilled! Wh-What should I do?!
I have to clean it up and get new soup—!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh no...! Is she going to push herself too hard all alone again...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone!
P-Please... help me out, um!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, could someone go to the kitchen and ask for more soup...?
Rice will handle cleaning this up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay! Leave it to meee!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Leave the cleaning to me as well♪ Rice-san, shouldn't you be getting "that" ready soon, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Allow me to take over hosting duties until the meal arrives.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text: Ah, ahh... thank you. So you've all been supporting Rice as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, we should be the ones thanking you. Rice-san has taken great care of us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Her sincere wish to make everyone happy... You cannot imagine how much strength that has given all of us.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Rice has...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: When she came to us asking for help to convey her feelings to her parents, we were truly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...It is about time. Please turn your attention to the stage.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *exhale*.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother.
I'm sorry for always causing trouble for you, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not what I should say. Thank you so, so much... for always cherishing Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And... to everyone else. Thank you so much for helping me put this party together. I'm so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice always thought that she was useless because she caused trouble for others. But—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Relying on others, and being relied upon, isn't a burden at all... It's something truly wonderful. Thanks to all of you, I finally realized that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So Rice wants to do her best to help bring happiness to everyone, too...! ...Please continue looking after me, um.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The party venue was filled with the sound of Rice Shower's parents weeping with joy, accompanied by never-ending applause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —On the way back to Tracen Academy from an errand, I overheard a married couple chatting nearby.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text: To think Rice has grown up so much. ...I'm happy, but part of me feels a little lonely, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: Indeed. But... she will always be our daughter, no matter what. ...Look over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Reluctant to part ways, Rice Shower waved her hands with all her might until the two of them were completely out of sight...!
